# Spine — drift correction

## Central claim

Drift is correctable from the imaging data alone, with no fiducial channel.

## Rungs

### R1 — methods

- establishes: drift is estimated from the imaging data alone
- opens: D1 (closed by R2) — whether an estimate taken from the data is accurate

### R2 — results

- establishes: the estimate is accurate enough to correct with
- closes: D1

### R3 — abstract

- establishes: drift is correctable with no fiducial channel
- restates: R2
